images.caption: Figure 1:Motivation for TerminalHorizon. Short trajectories can teach agents to perform terminal operations, but not to autonomously complete complex, long-horizon tasks. Our long-horizon trajectories connect agentic behavioral patterns, such as exploration, strategy revision, and verification, into a complete autonomous problem-solving process.

Figure 2:Overview of TerminalHorizon.
Challenge-guided synthesis refines task environments through independent execution to preserve core problem-solving work.
Progressive horizon expansion deepens tasks along the same goal to support richer agentic behavioral patterns.
